classification: Standalone C# simulation measurement; not Unity, persistence transaction, device or product economy acceptance
seeds: 1..20 sequential rounds for each independent campaign
purchasePolicy: Measurement-only policy, not a product auto-purchase feature. After settlement repeatedly buy cheapest uncapped meta upgrade; equal costs use enum order Damage,Supply,Growth,Harvest
milestonePolicy: 5 crystals per first new five completed waves, separate from normal; equivalent arithmetic, not CampaignSaveStore execution
limitations: Only Point/Balanced and one fixed purchase policy
Twenty finite rounds, no offline income
TestCompleted at wave60 is finite test completion, not natural defeat; explicitly counted
No retuning or product economy completion claim

sharedMetaComparison.definition: Same meta cloned after round19 Farming cheapest-purchase campaign; independent seed1..10 runs, no post-run purchases or milestone rewards
